title: Over the per-payment limit
story: Asha asks ShopBot to stock up for a family gathering, and the bulk order at FreshMart comes to INR 12,000. Her limit is INR 10,000 per payment. The Guard blocks it with PER_TXN_CAP_EXCEEDED: a single large mistake, or a manipulated assistant, can't empty the account in one go.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: We have twenty people coming on Sunday. Stock up on rice, oil and snacks, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The bulk order at FreshMart comes to INR 12,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: Four Reason codes, but only one of them blocks. The amount is high, the shop is new to this Mandate and there was no cart check: each of those would only ask Asha. The per-payment cap is a hard limit, so the strictest answer wins and no Consent request is made. Approving can never widen Asha's limit.
